about: Real Formula 1 cars from Wikimedia Commons: Edvvc's recordings at the Goodwood Festival of Speed hillclimb (2009 and 2010, CC BY-SA 3.0) unless an entry names another author and licence. The 2021 race recordings are the soundtracks of videos; the 240p transcodes on Commons carry the same soundtrack and were used. Each entry is cut from the original recording: from `start` to `end` seconds, with fades, normalised to `lufs`. `cue` is when the car launches, in seconds from the start of the cut.
